title: Task Metadata — Tier 1 (Full)
description: Full 5-goal metadata for the Task tool (subagent spawner). The agent type passed to Task is the primary KOTH signal: koth.agents_in_options should contain the agent being spawned. Oracle should be consulted before choosing the agent type. outcome_signal is set PostToolUse when the subagent completes.

notes.koth.agents_in_options: Single-element array containing the subagent_type being spawned. PostToolUse sets outcome_signal based on subagent success/failure.
notes.koth.oracle_consulted: Should be true — callers should consult Oracle before picking an agent type.
notes.decision.parent_decision_id: Set when this Task call is spawned by an existing decision context (e.g., orchestrator decision → researcher subagent).
notes.decision.signal_type: Typically 'post_decision' — the agent selection decision was already made before calling Task.
